title: 挑战 8 · 蓝色 LED：3.3V 还是 5V？
summary: 选择正确的电源模块电压，给蓝色 LED 足够的电流。
description:
蓝色 LED 的正向压降 Vf 约 3.0V，比红色高很多。用电源模块供电，跳线帽可以选 3.3V 或 5V，该选哪个？

• 3.3V：留给电阻的只有 3.3 − 3.0 = 0.3V。用 100Ω 时电流只有约 3mA，很暗；而且 Vf 稍有偏差就可能完全不亮。电压余量（headroom）太小。
• 5V：电阻上有 2V，用 100Ω 得到约 18mA，亮度合适、也更稳定。

要求：电源模块设为 5V，+5V → 100Ω → 蓝色 LED → GND。
（本题指定了 power_module 类型和 5V 电压：用电池或 3.3V 都不算对。）

en.title: Challenge 8 · Blue LED: 3.3V or 5V?
en.summary: Choose the right power module voltage to give a blue LED enough current.
en.description:
A blue LED's forward voltage Vf is about 3.0V, much higher than a red one. The power module's jumper cap can select 3.3V or 5V. Which should you pick?

• 3.3V: only 3.3 − 3.0 = 0.3V is left for the resistor. With 100Ω the current is only about 3mA, so it is very dim; and if Vf is a little off, it may not light at all. There is too little voltage headroom.
• 5V: 2V across the resistor; with 100Ω you get about 18mA, which is bright enough and more stable.

Task: set the power module to 5V, +5V → 100Ω → blue LED → GND.
(This challenge requires the power_module type at 5V: using a battery or 3.3V does not count.)
hints: Select the power module and change its voltage to 5V in the properties.
